links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy, completeness, and up-to-dateness of differential diagnoses and recommended exams
links.effect: Correct diagnosis identified in 96.2% of cases (80.8% first hypothesis); completeness and up-to-dateness scored lowest; failed to mention all diagnostic steps in 7.69% of cases.
links.quote: Despite the high accuracy rate, the assistant failed to mention all diagnostic steps in 7.69% of the cases.

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and completeness of a customized GPT-4 assistant on 26 retrospective clinical vignettes without testing a deployment practice or safeguard.
